discount_tax_note: ESTV practice since 1 May 2025: a conversion discount of up to 33 1/3% keeps the CLA a classic convertible; above that the CLA is non-classic (income tax on the discount, withholding complications). 33.33 approximates one third. Source: Walder Wyss Newsletter 214, 22 May 2025, https://www.walderwyss.com/assets/content/publications/250522_Newsletter-214_Key-Swiss-Tax-Practice-Update-Welcome-Adjustment-of-Loans.pdf
